mapper.select: SELECT sd.*, o.order_code, t.task_code, r.resource_name, t.operation_name FROM mes_schedule_detail sd LEFT JOIN mes_production_order o ON sd.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN mes_production_task t ON sd.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN mes_production_resource r ON sd.resource_id = r.id WHERE sd.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND sd.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sd.operation_sequence ASC, sd.planned_start_time ASC
mapper.insert:

( #{item.scheduleId}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.taskId}, #{item.resourceId}, #{item.operationSequence}, #{item.plannedStartTime}, #{item.plannedEndTime}, #{item.duration}, #{item.setupTime}, #{item.teardownTime}, #{item.status}, #{item.priority}, #{item.constraintType}, #{item.predecessorTaskId}, NOW(), NOW() )
